"N.B: Complaints regarding Answer Key in respect of  OMR  Examinations should be submitted online only through the OTR Profile of Candidates, within a period of 5 days from the date of publication of Provisional Answer Key(Both days included)".

 

The Final Answer Key, modified as per experts' opinion on the valid complaints received from candidates within the stipulated time, will be published in the website. The complaints received after the publication of Final Answer Key will not be entertained.
